Resting size is 0.15x depth, cancels are symmetric (0.996), nothing was one-sided, and the BUY order had a 57-lot fill before the 129-lot SELL fill. The 3-tick round trip is the spread earned between its own bid and ask, which the procedure treats as ordinary income. Feature (a) and feature (b) are both absent.
